content: Hello, thank you for answering. This is Evan from Amazon Seller Security Team. Is this Ms. Miller?
Yes, this is Karen Miller. What's going on?
I understand this may be worrying, but please stay calm. We detected some unusual activity linked to your Amazon seller account, and our team is here to help you sort it out.
Unusual activity? Oh no, I haven't been selling much lately. What kind of activity?

It's standard protocol for us to check in when there are discrepancies. It appears there was a flagged transaction related to restricted products, but sometimes this is just a mistake. Can I confirm your seller ID and the email registered with your Amazon account so we can proceed?
Uh, sure, my seller ID is KM987 and my email is karen.miller@email.com.

Thank you, Ms. Miller. Let me pull up your case. Please bear with me for a moment... Okay, I see the investigation is currently active, but it's still at an initial stage. I want to reassure you that we can resolve this today by following some verification steps.
I really need this account, I just lost my job and this is my only extra income. Is my account going to be closed?

I completely understand your concern. Our job is to protect your seller privileges. To keep your account active, we just need to verify some information and follow Amazon's dispute resolution. Would you be able to confirm your current mailing address and phone number for our records?
Yes, my address is 153 Walnut Ave, Brookfield, and my phone is 555-239-1112.
Perfect, thank you. Since this is a legal compliance issue, I am required to transfer you to my supervisor, Mr. Daniels, who will provide the next steps. Please stay on the line.
Okay, I'm here.
Hello, Ms. Miller, this is Mr. Daniels from Amazon Seller Compliance. First, I want to assure you that we take these matters seriously and are committed to helping honest sellers like you.
Thank you. I'm just scared I'll lose my account or get in trouble.

Your cooperation is what matters. To resolve this, Amazon policy requires a temporary legal processing fee to be settled before the investigation can be closed. This is standard and fully refundable once your status is cleared.
How much is the fee? I don't have much money right now.

I understand, and I'm here to help you through it. The fee is $425. We process these payments securely using either a wire transfer or a Bitcoin deposit, depending on what's most convenient for you. Which option would you prefer?
I guess I could try wire transfer, but why can't I just pay on the Amazon site?

That's a common question. Because this is a legal compliance matter managed by our security division, payment needs to be processed through our external compliance partner. I can give you the secure account details for the transfer.
Okay, write them down for me.

Certainly. Please send the $425 to the following account: Routing number 271921123, Account number 8841123059, Name: ASEC Services. Once you initiate the transfer, let me know so I can confirm receipt.
All right, I'll try to do it today. Will this fix the issue right away?

Yes, as soon as the payment is confirmed, we will submit the closure notice on the investigation. Your seller privileges will be fully restored, and you'll receive a confirmation email from our system.
I'm just nervous about giving out my info. Are you sure this is safe?

Absolutely. I assure you, all information is handled under strict Amazon privacy guidelines. If you have any hesitations, I can stay on the call with you while you complete the transfer for your peace of mind.
Okay, thank you. I'll go to the bank and do the transfer now.
Thank you for your cooperation, Ms. Miller. Please keep your transaction receipt and let me know as soon as it's complete so we can finalize your case.
